name: JBT Bancorp Inc.
summary: JBT Bancorp Inc. operates as the holding company for Jonestown Bank and Trust Company, delivering a full spectrum of banking services throughout Pennsylvania. The institution caters to both individual and business clients, offering diverse checking and savings accounts. Its lending portfolio encompasses business financing, home mortgages, as well as personal, auto, and home equity loans. Beyond core accounts and loans, JBT Bancorp provides an array of financial tools, including gift, reloadable, debit, and credit cards, alongside investment opportunities such as certificates of deposit (CDs) and individual retirement accounts (IRAs). The bank embraces modern technology, with digital wallet integration, online banking, and mobile banking services. It also supports businesses with specialized solutions, overdraft coverage, and autobook features. Additionally, the company offers tailored young adult banking programs, e-statements, secure night deposit and drop services, coin and currency ordering, and a robust debit card anti-fraud program. Established in 1873, JBT Bancorp Inc. is headquartered in Jonestown, Pennsylvania.
